title: Codec transition action
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $M$ with Boolean alphabet and a codec case consisting of an optional state, an optional input symbol, and one optional symbol for each work tape, define its action as follows: if the state is absent, the machine halts with no output, no head movement, and no work-tape writes; if the state is present, the action is the machine's transition on that state and the supplied symbols.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
A codec case containing an optional state, an optional input symbol, and optional symbols for all work tapes
